## Change and evidence

Describe the behavior, validation, limitations and release/rollback scope.

## Required staff dossier completion

- [ ] Agent duties, abilities, prompts, configuration, access, assessment or status changed? Name each affected canonical SW HQ dossier (or explicitly state no staff change).
- [ ] Dossier updated with dated executor/reviewer, evidence, version, limitations and deferred work; unsupported levels remain unassessed.
- [ ] Source/history completion gate and relevant local checks passed; historical ledgers unchanged; no paid testing.
- [ ] HQ synchronization confirmed, or linked same-work HQ patch explicitly marked pending.
- [ ] After release/rollback: record confirmed version, date and outcome in canonical release history; do not claim synchronization before deployment.
